3 دَارَسَتِ الآيَاتُ : see 1. ＝
-A2- دارس النَّاقَةَ: see 1. ―
-b2- دارس غَيْرَهُ (tropical:) [He read, or studied, with another, each of them teaching the other]. (A.) And دَارَسْتُهُ الكِتَابَ, inf. n. مُدَارَسَةٌ, (tropical:) [I read, or read repeatedly, or studied, or read and learned, with him the book, each of us teaching the other]. (A.) And دَارَسَهُمْ (assumed tropical:) He called to mind with them a subject of discourse, &c.; or he conferred with them; syn. ذَاكَرَهُمْ. (M.) See also 1, latter half, in five places.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
